preset.samsung: Samsung 4K TV (HDR10+, no Dolby Vision or DTS)
preset.lg: LG OLED 4K TV (Dolby Vision, no HDR10+ or DTS)
adjust.lang_no_audio: no audio track in this language
adjust.lang_none: neither audio nor subtitles in this language
audio.none_readable: No track playable on your hardware
audio.none_readable_note: None of the audio tracks can be played with the selected hardware.
codec.dev_note: Your hardware cannot play {codec}: playback is impossible or requires transcoding.
src.name: file name
src.remux_low: The name claims a remux, but the {what} video bitrate is only {vbr} Mb/s (a remux is above {min} Mb/s). Source corrected to “{label}”.
chk.atmos_unconfirmed: {claimed} claimed, but ffprobe only reports {base}. Atmos is not always detected by older versions.
chk.audio_missing: The name claims {claimed}, which is missing from the audio tracks.
chk.bitrate_estimated: Video bitrate is estimated (the file does not state it): the bitrate score is less accurate.
chk.channels: The name claims {claimed}, but the best track has {top} channels.
chk.codec_mismatch: The name claims {claimed}, but the actual codec is {real}.
chk.dv_unannounced: Dolby Vision is present but not stated in the name.
chk.hdr_8bit: 8-bit HDR: risk of visible color banding.
chk.lang_weaker: The {language} track ({mine}) is clearly worse than the best track ({best}).
chk.low_4k: Heavily compressed 4K: the picture is probably upscaled or badly degraded.
chk.low_bluray: Very low bitrate for a file labeled BluRay.
chk.no_audio: No audio track in this file.
chk.no_dv: The name claims Dolby Vision, but no Dolby Vision layer is present.
chk.no_hdr: The name claims HDR, but the video is SDR.
chk.no_hdr10plus: HDR10+ claimed but not detected (detection is done on the first frame).
chk.no_lang: Neither audio track nor subtitles in {language}.
chk.partial: Detailed analysis is impossible: only the name and source are scored.
chk.remux_lossy: Remux without lossless HD audio: the original track may have been removed.
chk.res_mismatch: The name claims {claimed}, but the video is {w}×{h}.
chk.short_file: Very short file ({minutes} min): a sample?
ver.aspect: Different aspect ratio: A {a}:1, B {b}:1. One version may be cropped or full-frame IMAX.
ver.chapters: Different number of chapters: A {a}, B {b}.
ver.duration: Different durations: A {a}, B {b} (gap of {gap}). These are probably two different cuts (theatrical, director's cut, IMAX...): the frames and VMAF would compare different scenes.
ver.fps: Different frame rate: A {a}, B {b} fps.{hint}
ver.pal: One is probably the 25 fps version, sped up by 4% (PAL standard).
ver.small_gap: Slight duration gap ({s} s): a small start offset is possible.
rep.no_criteria: No comparable criteria between these two files.
rep.nothing: No criterion really makes a difference.
rep.partial: (Partial comparison: some criteria could not be evaluated.)
rep.size_gain: {big} is {extra} GB larger than {small} ({gbig} GB vs {gsmall} GB) for {gain} more points, i.e. {per_gb} pt per extra GB.
rep.size_no_gain: {big} is {extra} GB larger than {small} ({gbig} GB vs {gsmall} GB) without scoring higher: {small} is more efficient.
rep.winner_a: File A is of better quality, leading by {gap} points.
rep.winner_b: File B is of better quality, leading by {gap} points.
csv.name: name
csv.title: title
up.summary: {total} files analyzed · {films} movie(s) and {seasons} season(s) to improve · {ok} file(s) already at the target level.
tor.invalid: This file is not a valid torrent.
tor.magnet_no_name: This magnet link has no name (dn parameter): nothing to analyze.
tor.not_magnet: This is not a magnet link.
tor.note_codec: Codec missing from the name: {codec} assumed.
tor.note_estimated: Estimated from the torrent name: the file was not read.
tor.note_multi: Several video files (season or batch): only the largest is analyzed.
tor.note_runtime: Bitrate estimated with an assumed duration of {min} min.
tor.note_size: Unknown size: the bitrate cannot be estimated.
mi.note: Data read from a pasted MediaInfo report (the file itself is not analyzed).
mi.unrecognized: MediaInfo report not recognized: no “Video” section. Paste the full report (Text view).
pr.iso_unreadable: Disc content unreadable by FFmpeg ({error}). Only the name is analyzed.
pr.not_found: ffprobe not found. Install FFmpeg (winget install Gyan.FFmpeg) or specify the location of ffprobe.exe.
vm.no_frame: File {tag}: unable to extract a frame at this time.
vm.timeout: {what}: timed out ({min} min). The file is very large or the disk is too slow at this point in the video.
web.add_folder_first: Add at least one folder first.
web.estimated_note: Estimated from the name and size: the file is not read.
web.folder_cap: Folder limited to the first {n} videos.
web.internal_error: Internal error ({kind}: {msg}). Details in the log.
web.is_folder: This is a folder: a slot accepts a single file. To analyze a whole folder, use the Library.
web.no_video: No video found in these folders.
web.nothing_to_export: There is nothing to export: run an analysis first.
web.reopen_failed: Unable to reopen: file not found or report pasted by hand. {names}
web.visual_hint: Compares the actual picture of both files on a few excerpts. The VMAF measurement takes one to a few minutes.
web.visual_unavailable: Available for two video files on this computer (not for torrents, magnets or MediaInfo reports) and if FFmpeg is installed.
web.visual_unavailable_short: Visual comparison unavailable for these items.
web.vmaf_hdr: Warning: one video is HDR. It is converted to SDR for the measurement, and VMAF is unreliable with HDR: treat this score as an indication.
web.vmaf_result: File {dist} looks like file {ref} at {score} out of 100 ({desc}). Measured on {n} excerpts of {sec} s, scaled down to 1080p at most, with file {ref} as the reference: a gap between the two, not an absolute score.{hdr}
cli.audio_pref: none: no preference, any: audio or subtitles in the language, audio: audio required
cli.description: Compares the quality of video files, torrents or magnets.
cli.elements: videos, folders, .torrent files or magnet links (2 minimum)
cli.ffprobe: path to ffprobe if not in PATH
cli.need_two: Error: at least two items are needed to compare.
cli.output: writes the report to this text file instead of displaying it
cli.runtime: assumed duration in minutes to estimate the bitrate of torrents
ui.by_criterion_sub: Each bar is a score out of 100.
ui.clear_all_hint: The entire history will be deleted.
ui.compare_sub: Put one file in each slot. The result appears right below.
ui.dev_path_hint: Development mode: enter the full path.
ui.diag_hint: VidCompare {version}. If something doesn't work, the error log helps understand why.
ui.drop_no_path: Unable to read this file's path: use “Choose a video”.
ui.drop_sub: A video, a .torrent file or a magnet link
ui.engine_down_sub: The interface cannot reach the VidCompare engine. Restart the app.
ui.ffmpeg_banner: FFmpeg (ffprobe) not found: videos cannot be read. Install it with “winget install Gyan.FFmpeg” or specify ffprobe.exe.
ui.films_sub: From the biggest possible gain to the smallest.
ui.frames_alt: Compared frame, A on the left and B on the right
ui.frames_hdr: HDR frames are converted to SDR to be comparable.
ui.group_hint: The group name is the end of the file name, after the last hyphen.
ui.history_sub: Every comparison is kept here. Repeating the same comparison updates its row.
ui.library_sub: Rank several versions, or spot what would be worth getting in better quality.
ui.magnet_hint: Paste the full magnet link (it must contain a name: dn parameter).
ui.no_scan: Add your movie and series folders, then start the analysis. The app tells you what to aim for, not where to find it.
ui.nothing_to_improve: Nothing to improve at this level.
ui.partial: Partial comparison: some criteria could not be evaluated for both files (estimated torrent or magnet, pasted report or unreadable disc).
ui.path_any: Path of a file or folder
ui.rank_empty: Add videos, a folder, torrents or magnets (or drag them here) to rank them.
ui.rank_estimated: Torrents and magnets are estimated from their name and size: their score is less reliable.
ui.reasons_sub: What weighs most in the gap.
ui.report_hint: Paste the full report (Text view). It is often found on a torrent's page: the file is not read.
ui.saved_in_history: This comparison is kept in the history.
ui.set_content_lang_hint: Deducts a few points from versions without this language in audio or subtitles.
ui.set_device_hint: Anything that can't be played is penalized: Dolby Vision becomes HDR10.
ui.set_groups_hint: A bonus or penalty of -10 to +10 points. Empty by default: the app judges no group for you.
ui.set_theme_hint: OLED mode uses pure black: pixels switch off on an OLED screen.
ui.set_torrents_hint: Assumed movie duration, to estimate the bitrate from the size.
ui.set_weights_hint: Choose a profile, or adjust the importance of each criterion in the final score.
ui.settings_sub: What matters to you in the score, what your hardware can play, and the appearance.
ui.versions_title: Worth knowing before comparing the picture
ui.versions_title_block: These two files do not seem to be the same cut
ui.vmaf_confirm_body: If the two files do not show the same scenes at the same moment, the score is meaningless. Only measure if you know it is the same cut.
ui.vmaf_tip: VMAF: a Netflix metric that rates from 0 to 100 how closely one video resembles another
ui.set_update_hint: VidCompare can check whether a newer version exists. It makes one request to github.com and sends no personal data.
ui.update_auto: Check automatically at launch (once a day)
web.update_failed: Could not reach GitHub to check for updates.
ui.scan_listing: Looking for videos in your folders…
